versions.text: Criterion: Verify that control harmony is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.4.5 Control harmony (see table LXXIX for guidance). For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets standards within ADS-33-PRF, 3.6.5 Control harmony. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

Standard: Simultaneous control forces do not exceed the limits as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Control Harmony paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the control forces required to execute maneuvers requiring combined control input as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Control Harmony paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the control forces required to execute maneuvers requiring combined control input as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Control Harmony paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the control forces required to execute maneuvers requiring combined control input as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Control Harmony paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
